title: Top 24 Gumbo Spots in New Orleans
author: Jules

items.name: Gumbo Shop
items.theAll24Take: A classic for a reason. The Gumbo Shop serves up a rich, dark roux gumbo that's a must-try for any visitor.
items.theVitals: 630 St Peter St, New Orleans, LA 70116

items.name: Commander's Palace
items.theAll24Take: An upscale take on the classic, Commander's Palace offers a refined gumbo experience in a beautiful setting.
